summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for mobile dropdown overhaul, geo dataset, auth/admin selector behavior, customs/command-center selectors, and responsive checks. Most critical flows pass on mobile touch; found one backend coverage mismatch and one frontend expo dropdown first-open race.

minor.issue: Returns only 16 countries (not full 250). Frontend is currently compensating with offline dataset, but endpoint itself is limited.

ui_bugs.issue: First open can render empty options (0) on mobile; closing and reopening then shows full list (~252 including 'All countries').
At 768px menu uses mobile flat links; explicit Explore/Learn grouped touch entries are not present as separate menu groups.

integration_issues.issue: Logged-in test account did not expose editable verify country/state/city controls in current account state (likely already-verified or different step).

action_items: Fix expo country picker first-open empty state/race so options are available on initial open.
Decide whether /api/countries must be expanded to 250 for consistency with frontend offline geo model.
Confirm desired tablet IA: either explicit Explore/Learn grouped entries or accept current flat mobile nav list.
Retest verify selector coverage using a guaranteed unverified account if strict /verify field interaction is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Geo static dataset and on-demand country file loading are correctly wired (250 countries, per-country JSON present, no duplicate ISO codes).
LocationSelect guards stale async responses using an 'active' flag; previous country loads are ignored after country switch.
Manual locality fallback is implemented via ResponsiveSelect allowCustom and works for city/state custom entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile dropdown interactions validated across signup/event/tools/brain/customs/command-center/admin modal selectors. Key reproducible defect: /expo country dropdown can open empty on first open, then populates after close+reopen. Auth succeeded for user/admin with provided credentials, but verify form selectors were not available in tested account state.
rca of the issue: Expo filter options depend on async filter hydration and/or first dialog render path. Repro: open /expo on mobile, tap country filter immediately -> option list count can be 0; close and reopen -> options appear (~252). Likely initial options not ready/rendered when dialog first mounts. Mitigation: ensure picker blocks opening until filter options are hydrated, or re-trigger options render on first open.
